distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Ficicis porcatus as occurring in Taiwan. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: The source states that hosts are usually Moraceae, especially Ficus and Artocarpus. Because no individual species is given, these host statements are retained as family/genus-level ecological context rather than expanded into species.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ficicis porcatus (Chapuis, 1869).
